svg.title: N0zoM1z0 · Contribution Arcade · 07 / SPACE INVADERS
svg.desc: 19,817 GitHub contributions across 160 active days, 2025-11-02 to 2026-11-05. The ship fires at real contribution dates in ascending count order. Invaders disappear only on projectile impact. A streak of seven consecutive active dates unlocks a boss.
